formal_role: Defines modeled space used for projection or approximation
systems_modeling_role: Determines what structure the model can represent
review_warning: Changing the subspace changes what becomes signal and residual

formal_role: Defines how basis vectors are selected or orthogonalized
systems_modeling_role: Determines numerical stability and interpretability of components
review_warning: Basis choice should be documented especially when variables are correlated or scaled differently

formal_role: Defines how modeled component is computed
systems_modeling_role: Determines whether approximation uses direct projection QR SVD or another method
review_warning: Method choice affects numerical stability and auditability

formal_role: Defines numerical threshold for independent directions
systems_modeling_role: Determines whether small directions are retained or discarded
review_warning: Numerical rank depends on scaling tolerance and modeling purpose

formal_role: Defines how unexplained variation is treated
systems_modeling_role: Determines whether residuals are noise missing structure outliers or model failure
review_warning: Residuals should not be dismissed as noise without review

systems_modeling_role: Supports stability assessment and method selection
review_warning: Ill-conditioned systems require careful solver choice and diagnostic reporting

formal_role: Defines how approximation quality is evaluated
systems_modeling_role: Connects residual size and captured structure to the system question
review_warning: Small residuals do not guarantee meaningful or responsible interpretation
